text: One strong run could be luck. Soren re-runs the whole pipeline eight separate times to find out if it actually is.
Eight different random starting points, eight fresh optimizations, eight fresh 20,000-shot samples -- each checked against Felix's one, fixed, brute-force answer.
All eight runs land on exactly the same top answer Felix already proved was optimal, with shot concentration never dropping below 65%.
Soren, Helena, and Felix sign off together: on the simulator, this is validated, not just promising.
Next: taking this exact pipeline to real IBM Quantum hardware.
